profile.name: Michael Borck
profile.title: AI Leader & Cyber Security Expert
profile.summary: AI Leader and Cyber Security expert with 35+ years spanning military → academia → industry consulting. Author of the "Learning with AI" open-textbook series (Conversation, Not Delegation; The Human Edge; Speak Software; Model Data, Verify AI, plus domain companions), creator of innovative educational AI tools, and a leader in AI-enhanced pedagogy serving academics, education, agriculture and mining sectors. Founder of LocoLabo, a self-funded applied-AI research lab (12 projects, 52 GPUs, $0 sponsorship) mapping what small local models can do on hardware people already own, with a rare combination of technical depth and educational innovation expertise. Teaching philosophy grounded in three conceptual pillars - Caring, Competence, and Passion, with a core principle of "Make Contact Count."
profile.tagline: Make Contact Count - maximising impact through every student interaction

teaching_philosophy.core: Make Contact Count - maximising impact through every student interaction
teaching_philosophy.framework: Built on three pillars - Caring, Competence, and Passion
teaching_philosophy.approach: Grounded in Constructivist learning theory, Bloom's Taxonomy, and Universal Design for Learning (UDL)

satisfaction.details: Across 38 unit deliveries since 2019 (eVALUate to 2022, Insight from 2023); all six survey dimensions at or above 80% - Assessments 89.2%, Engagement 86.8%, Expectations 85.5%, Resources 84.9%, Support 81.2%
Top results sustained across 8 units, alongside a 12% average pass-rate uplift in AI-redesigned units and a return to 100% in Semester 2 2025 after the 2024 AI transition
Undergraduate, postgraduate and executive education - a range few academics deliver across - online and on-campus, domestic and international (China), from small specialist classes to cohorts of 300
